home.title: Olive oil, quite simply good.
home.intro: Cold-pressed oils, olives picked when ripe and a few good things to put on the table. Nothing more, nothing less.

mill.title: From the orchard to the bottle, no detour.
mill.intro: We pick, we press, we bottle. No middleman, no blend from elsewhere: what is written on the label is what is inside.
mill.photoOrchard: Harvest in the olive grove, morning light
mill.photoBread: A drizzle of oil on toasted bread

picked.title: Picked by hand
picked.text: At the right ripeness, variety by variety.

bottled.title: Bottled at the mill
bottled.text: In tinted glass, away from light.

taste.title: Which fruity oil is made for you?

green.name: Green fruity
green.notes: Cut grass, artichoke, fresh almond. Lively, slightly pungent at the finish.

ripe.name: Ripe fruity
ripe.notes: Dried fruit, ripe apple, white flowers. Soft and round, very little bitterness.
ripe.pairings: Pasta, poultry, pastries made with oil

black.name: Black fruity
black.notes: Candied olive, cocoa, undergrowth. An old-style taste with no bitterness or pungency.
